about us

Executive Search

Kintec’s permanent recruitment specialists know that finding the right full-time staff for your business requires a different approach to that taken when delivering contracting resources. We listen and learn from our clients and the Kintec team combines its own diversified industry experience to help develop a broad understanding of the many different criteria a successful permanent placement must meet.

Our approach is a focus on the long-term outlook, with attention to detail paramount. The Kintec team marries keen appreciation of specific business cultures and objectives to time invested in diligent investigation and assessment of candidate suitability.

See how our permanent recruitment services can help you
